Deductions: English stem + Korean ending 'short-circuit하고' (L270), 'short-circuit해도' (L282) -> '건너뛰고', '건너뛰어도'; calque '첫 번째 파티 프로바이더' (L891) -> 'SDK가 직접 제공하는 프로바이더'; formulaic '반복 횟수를 제한하는 장치와 기록을 줄이는 장치가 함께 필요한 까닭이 여기에 있습니다' (L113), '이유가 여기서 보입니다' (L520), '결국 호출의 결과는 두 갈래로 나뉩니다' (L881), '정리하면 Strands는 ...' score_evidence.C: One running example (order-support agent) threads every section, and back-references mostly resolve (send_email L195, lookup_order L553, OrderRetryStrategy L644, cedar L558 reused in handle_request L976). Deductions: L964 says handle_request adds 'Deny 인터벤션' and the earlier configuration, but the assembled agent silently breaks (Cedar denies the CustomerInfo tool); L1030 '앞서 붙인 ... Deny/HumanInTheLoop 개입, handle_request의 호출 한도' implies HITL is in handle_request, which it is not; L617 steering escalation uses intervention method names (after_model_call/before_model_call) although the steering page says 'in Python, steering handlers are plugins'.
score_evidence.D: Hard parts get worked examples: quadratic input-token growth with a formula (L107-113), hook ordering with order values (L156-161), limit overshoot table (L790-797), Cedar -> HITL short-circuit flow (L513-520), 2/4/8 s backoff (L654). Padding: the loop is described three times (L13, L21, L62-67) and L91 restates it again.
score_evidence.E: Useful tables (writable fields L167, allowed actions L499, structured-output outcomes L474, retry defaults L629, cancel checkpoints L836, stop reasons L869) and ASCII diagrams (L36, L71, L133, L274). Deductions: the compression inequality (L746) only restates a one-line docs condition; table L479 'no limit' cell for content filter is an extrapolation the docs do not state.
score_evidence.F: All 15 sampled claims supported. Wrong or unsupported outside the sample: (1) L964-998 handle_request: the Cedar policy (L560-565) permits only lookup_order and send_email, so the structured-output tool 'CustomerInfo' is denied ('DENIED: Access denied by Cedar policy', reproduced); the handler loops until limit_turns and always returns BUDGET_EXCEEDED with customer=None, contradicting L998 '응답 내용은 정상 완료일 때만 내보냅니다' (same defect class as v5's RefundDecision). (2) L328 '등록 호출은 정리 함수를 반환하며, 이 함수를 부르면 핸들러가 제거됩니다' follows Python code, but Python add_middleware returns None and its docstring says 'Handlers cannot be removed once registered'; the docs state the cleanup function for TypeScript only. (3) L1006 'AWS 블로그가 정리한 배치 방식 ... 도구는 Lambda, 에이전트는 Fargate ... return-of-control 패턴' is in none of the cited sources (the cited AWS ML blog has no Fargate or return-of-control). (4) L479 table: content-filter outcome without a limit is extrapolated (docs state it only under Limit attempts).
